name: Data.normSqAt_goodProjTranslate_le
summary: Each value is a sum over 𝖦 of translates with coefficients |𝖦|e₀(t), whose conjugates sum to at most |𝖦|; the class sum adds the number of classes.

steps.claim: For every s: |σ(|𝖦|e₀(s))| is at most the total Σ_t|σ(|𝖦|e₀(t))|, which is bounded by the convolution norm bound for the conjugated central projection (sum_norm_conv_le).
steps.lean:
have k s := by simpa [apply_ite, inv_mul_eq_one] using (Finset.single_le_sum (by simp)
    (Finset.mem_univ s)).trans ((D.isCentralProj_e₀.map σ).sum_norm_conv_le (.id _)
    (Pi.single 1 (1 : ℂ)))

steps.claim: Bound the class-sum norm by the number of classes times the square of a bound for the values (classSum_le_card_mul_sq); each value is the sum of iota_goodProjTranslate_apply, bounded by h and step 1; the number of classes by card_stdClasses_le_exp with card_Y_le.
steps.lean:
grw [LevelForm.normSqAt, classSum_le_card_mul_sq fun g ↦ by
    erw [iota_goodProjTranslate_apply]; grw [sqrt_weylNormSq_sum_le]; simp [-Fintype.card_pi]; grw
      [h, k], D.card_stdClasses_le_exp
    (principalLevel_le_levelOf (·.rec (mul_mem_right _ _ ·.2.2.1) nofun)) (D.card_Y_le .refl)]

steps.claim: |GL| divides the chosen group order (card_GL_dvd_chosenGroupOrder), which is at most its exponential; the remaining inequality holds on the scales (le_of_hasLogBound, lt_of_hasLogBound).
steps.lean:
grw [Nat.le_of_dvd Fin.pos' (D.card_GL_dvd_chosenGroupOrder D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound),
    le_exp_log D.chosenGroupOrder]; use D.le_of_hasLogBound D.lt_of_hasLogBound
